content:
GrobidStructureEnricher — implementation plan:

1. Modify alcanzai-understanding/pyproject.toml — add httpx>=0.27 dependency
2. Create alcanzai-understanding/src/alcanzai_understanding/grobid_enricher.py:
   - _NS, _DEFAULT_GROBID_URL, _GROBID_TIMEOUT constants
   - helpers: _clean_text, _el_text, _parse_heading_level, _extract_blocks, _extract_metadata
   - GrobidStructureEnricher class implementing Enricher protocol
   - enricher_id='grobid-structure', priority=10, applies_to(ACADEMIC_PDF)=True
   - enrich(): reads artifact_path → reads PDF bytes → POSTs to GROBID → parses TEI XML → returns EnrichmentResult
   - All GROBID failures set EnrichmentResult.error, never raise
   - data keys: grobid_blocks (list[ContentBlock]), grobid_metadata (dict), grobid_tei_xml (raw str for CitationEnricher)
3. Create tests/test_grobid_enricher.py — ~28 unit tests with pytest-httpx mocks
   - Tests: properties, applies_to, ContentTypeMismatchError, missing artifact_path, missing file, HTTP error, timeout, bad XML, successful parse, block kinds/order/levels, metadata extraction
   
No OTel (stripped for M2 per ADR-011 planning). Uses httpx (consistent with ArxivSource). Uses stdlib ET (consistent with ArxivSource). GROBID URL from ALCANZAI_GROBID_URL env var.
